caption: God promises David a ruling descendant; Matthew calls Jesus the son of David. It is a real dynastic link—but Solomon is the immediate promised heir.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did God promise Jesus to David? God says David’s own descendant will rule after him. Matthew opens by calling Jesus the son of David.
slides.body: God says David’s own descendant will rule after him. Matthew opens by calling Jesus the son of David.
slides.heading: Did God promise Jesus to David?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of 2Sam 7:12: I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from your own body.
slides.body: I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from your own body.
slides.heading: 2Sam 7:12

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Matt 1:1, BSB: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
slides.body: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Matt 1:1

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: The Davidic link is deliberate Matthew traces Jesus through David and Solomon. Christians see him as the final king promised to David’s family.
slides.body: Matthew traces Jesus through David and Solomon. Christians see him as the final king promised to David’s family.
slides.heading: The Davidic link is deliberate

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But Solomon comes first Solomon succeeds David and builds the temple mentioned next. Davidic ancestry alone does not identify one descendant.
slides.body: Solomon succeeds David and builds the temple mentioned next. Davidic ancestry alone does not identify one descendant.
slides.heading: But Solomon comes first

title: David's promised descendant
